text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek baked a whole batch of 
madeleines to share with her friends, but—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Still... this is quite a predicament.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I made a portion for myself too, but while 
handing them out, it was already night...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can't eat sweets at this hour... but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...If it's just a little bit, will it be 
okay?
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.
You mean you're giving it to someone?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, just for a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it tasted so delicious when I 
sampled it, so I've really been looking 
forward to eating it~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. To make up for what we ate, we'll 
have to work hard at training tomorrow♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek hummed as she brewed tea and 
enjoyed some madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, ever since I started making it, 
I've been looking forward to it. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, since we have the chance, let's brew 
some tea. Would you care for a cup too, 
Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek hummed as she brewed tea and 
thoroughly enjoyed some madeleines.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Y... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I think I shall enjoy the madeleines 
tomorrow morning instead.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Must endure, must endure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Squeezing her eyes tightly shut, Super 
Creek resisted the madeleine."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Come to think of it... when I gave 
some to Oguri-chan, she looked like she 
wanted more."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Well then, shall we let 
Oguri-chan have my share?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Watching Oguri-chan happily stuffing her 
face... Ah, I'm already looking forward to 
it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... Super Creek was said to have 
thoroughly relished the sight of Oguri Cap 
stuffing her face with madeleines.
